title: Follow the Money
staging:
Scene 09 — Follow the Money

07:30–08:40 · 70 sec · Resistance hacking lair

The crew analyzes the price data. Ghost identifies unusual encrypted communications between Goodboy Global and WOOF7. Neon traces the meeting invitation to the luxury restaurant Steak & Bone.

Shots: Monitor close-ups → Ghost's green visor → rotating encrypted message hologram → restaurant location map.
